hadith:
Funerals (Al-Janaa'iz) - Narrated `Aisha:

The Prophet (p.b.u.h) said, "Don't abuse the dead, because they have reached the result of what they forwarded."
message: Allah has granted us abundant blessings in this life, and we are reminded to treat all people—including those who have passed—with respect and dignity, for they will answer for their deeds. As Al-Mu'eed, the Restorer, Allah brings back life after death and grants second chances through His infinite mercy, so we should focus on good deeds and seek forgiveness while we have the opportunity.
name:
Al Mu'eed - الْمُعِيدُ - The Restorer

The origin of the name Al Mu'eed comes from the Arabic root word 'ع و د' (ʿ-w-d), which signifies the act of returning or bringing back. In Islamic belief, this name emphasizes Allah's attribute of restoring creation and granting second chances, whether in terms of guidance, forgiveness, or the revival of life after death.
verse:
Al-Kawthar - The Abundance - 108:1

Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.
